needs_validation.title: Windows Linker Toolchain Limitation
needs_validation.description: On Windows developer environments without MSVC link.exe or Windows SDK, binary test linking fails unless an external linker (such as rust-lld with appropriate SDK paths or a Linux container) is provided. Cargo check and clippy compile cleanly.
needs_validation.reproduction_plan: Execute cargo nextest inside the containerized Linux CI environment as configured in .github/workflows/ci.yml
